_doc: ADR-0033: registry of chosen-to-defer (pending-activation) items only. Declared-gap permanents live in coverage-map.json; chosen-not-to-build items (e.g. judgeSeam, ADR-0019 D4) stay in ADRs per MADR. review_at expiry is fail-closed: activate, re-defer with new review_at + rationale, or remove. Enforced by scripts/check-deferred.js (deferred:gate).

entries.subject: supply-chain signing (sigstore keyless / SLSA provenance)
entries.rationale: Single maintainer, local-only distribution (no remote, no npm publish, no CI): signing infrastructure buys nothing until at least one distribution channel exists. ADR-0029 D7 registers signing as a rejected-for-now item with explicit re-activation conditions.

unfreeze_if.check: git remote exists AND npm publish configured AND CI pipeline exists

entries.subject: L1/L2 golden gate deepening for the 8 long-tail host adapters
entries.rationale: L1/L2 golden conformance is suspended until the 8 long-tail host protocols are verified against official docs; shipping L1 gates on unverified protocols would codify guesses as gold.

unfreeze_if.check: the 8 long-tail host protocols verified against official docs AND the copilot-cli sessionStart bugs (issues 1730, 2201, 2415, 2142) resolved upstream

entries.subject: Merkle tree / signature upgrade of the evidence hash chain
entries.rationale: Single-repo single-actor chains gain nothing from Merkle batching; the current linear hash chain is auditable end-to-end. Deferred per CONTEXT.md Cross-Turn Hash Chain terminology.

unfreeze_if.check: a second-party consumer of the evidence log exists outside the producing repository, OR a cross-machine verification requirement appears
